response.overview: Marissa, a determined investigator haunted by the disappearance of her sister and countless other children, becomes obsessed with uncovering the truth behind a child trafficking network. As the investigation intensifies, all clues point toward Richard, a mysterious money courier who may hold the answers she has been searching for. However, as trust begins to crumble and hidden agendas emerge, Marissa discovers that the greatest threat may be closer than she ever imagined
response.tagline: The truth was closer than she thought.
